subject: Judge skill: add code-review rubric + single-attempt gate
description: Expand skills/self-learn-judge/SKILL.md so the judge evaluates the CODE ARTIFACT, not just outcomes. Today it judges only metrics (measurement vs baseline/guardrails/benchmark) or test pass/fail + inferred rationale — it never reads the diff. Add: (1) a code-review step that fetches each attempt's diff via the new /attempt/diff endpoint and assesses correctness, scope discipline (only touched files_in_scope), dead/redundant code left behind, test presence & quality, and style match — this is the 'did it clean up / is the test real' semantic check. In metric mode this is a tiebreaker/near-veto; in fallback mode it REPLACES the current vibe-based rationale with an actual read of the code. (2) A single-attempt 'tournament of one' gate: today the judge needs >=2 rivals; allow the degenerate case where one attempt's code review IS the verdict — approve (merge/hold-merge) or kick back to failed/reopen with a wired decision note. No new daemon behavior — compose existing tools + the new diff endpoint. Record the code-review findings in the verdict knowledge attached to P.

summary: Expanded skills/self-learn-judge/SKILL.md to judge the CODE ARTIFACT, not just outcomes. Added: (1) step 2b "Read the code" fetching each attempt's diff via get_attempt_diff (GET /attempt/diff) + a new "Code-review rubric" section (correctness, scope discipline, dead/redundant code, test presence/quality, style match) — wired as a near-veto tiebreaker in metric mode and as the replacement for vibe-based rationale in fallback mode; (2) a "Single-attempt (tournament of one) gate" section: when exactly one attempt exists, the code review IS the verdict (APPROVE → merge/hold-merge per mode; KICK BACK → set_status failed + wired record_decision), preserving the HOLD-MERGE default; (3) a code_review:{winner_notes,concerns[]} field in the verdict JSON, plus HOLD-MERGE banner + Guardrails notes ("read the code, never just the green"). Edits surgical/additive; metric-aware + guardrails sections preserved. No daemon/code changes. Committed to orch/attempt branch (fe9030b).
